What is the value of $c$ and $d$?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}5(2x+1)+c(x+d)&=10x+5+cx+cd\\&=(10+c)x+5+cd\end{align*}$$
Compare coefficients of $x$:
$$\begin{align*}10+c&=12\\c&=2\end{align*}$$
Compare constants and substitute $c=2$:
$$\begin{align*}5+2d&=-1\\2d&=-6\\d&=-3\end{align*}$$
